(2) Instagram bio via imginn.com mirror (official web_profile_info API returned 400 'asset deleted' error, used documented fallback) returned no bio text/external_url field populated for this account. (3) Instagram direct page fetch scanned for biography/business_email/external_url fields, none found in returned markup. (4) Facebook page (facebook.com/massagewithcharisma, found via Booksy sameAs) is blocked by Facebook's login wall for unauthenticated fetches, About section not accessible. website_check.conclusion: Confirmed: has_own_site = false. All booking and web presence runs through Booksy + Instagram + Facebook, no owned domain in any variant tested.

brand_vibe.name: charisma
brand_vibe.description: Derived from the real studio photo and logo: cream/warm-white walls and linens, deep teal accents (blanket, monogram logo, uniform scrub color), warm candlelight, natural wood tray, small potted greenery. Coastal quiet-luxury: 'Heal. Relax. Restore.' Not neon-spa, not clinical; warm Gulf Coast spa softness.

cta_note: Primary CTA is Booksy online booking (real-time availability), consistent across nav, hero, service cards, and floating button. Secondary CTA is click-to-call.
build_notes: Base clara (light template, ejemplar Amani) retinted to a custom teal/cream 'charisma' palette derived from the business's real logo and studio photo (not one of the 5 pre-set palettes in DESIGN.md, since none matched this brand's real teal; followed the documented pattern of deriving brand_vibe tokens from research). Bilingual EN(default)/ES implemented with the standard data-es/data-en toggle plus applyLang() running before the hero split-text JS (same pattern as output/oddjobrob). Only 6 real distinct photos were available for a mobile/home-based single-therapist business with no physical storefront to photograph extensively; per pipeline guidance ('fewer sections rather than padding with bad photos'), the gallery uses 5 tiles: gallery-mall-event.jpg as the col-span-2 flagship tile (it is naturally landscape) and hero-studio.jpg reused as a second gallery tile (matching the precedent already established in the light ejemplar template itself, which reuses hero-1.jpg and space-2.jpg across its own hero/about/gallery sections). No <details>/accordion anywhere; all 7 services shown as visible glass cards. Location section adapted to describe the private appointment-only studio address plus the full mobile service area list, since the business has no public walk-in storefront. Verified with Playwright at 390px viewport: no horizontal overflow, 0 console/page errors besides an expected offline Google Fonts network error, EN/ES toggle correctly relabels the split-word h1, JSON-LD parses, em-dash count 0.
